input_semantics.description:
SLOT: name | TYPE: STRING | ENUM: null | REQUIRED: false
MEANING: IDENTIFIER.NAME | 补充：当任务为“比较/最早/最晚/最小值”时，name 仅作为定位条件之一；必须先对齐全部候选实体名称集合，并为每个候选补齐并查询到可比较的 LISTING_DATE（缺失则继续补查或声明无法比较），不得在只拿到部分候选结果时直接下结论。

SLOT: code | TYPE: STRING | ENUM: null | REQUIRED: false
MEANING: IDENTIFIER.CODE | 补充：用于精确定位 A 股标的，比较上市时间/最早最晚时优先使用 code 以确保同口径取数；必须对齐全部候选并对每个候选查询到 LISTING_DATE 后，显式执行比较（如取 MIN/MAX）再回答；任一候选 code/日期缺失需先补查，否则不得凭常识推断。 | 注意：涉及上市日期比较必填优先用code

output_semantics.description: 股票的上市日期(格式 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 或者一个描述性的错误信息字符串。

description:
SELECT LISTING_DATE
FROM A_SHARE
WHERE IDENTIFY BY (CODE = <code> OR NAME = <name>)
[CONSTRAINT]
- For compare/earliest/latest/min/max questions: first align the full candidate set (e.g., all “三大航” members), then obtain LISTING_DATE for every candidate using the same comparable field (prefer CODE if available), and only answer after an explicit comparison (e.g., MIN(LISTING_DATE)).
- If any candidate’s LISTING_DATE is missing/unretrieved, you MUST query/补查 that candidate (via CODE/NAME) or state “无法比较/信息不足”; never guess from partial results or common knowledge.
- Use LISTING_DATE as the authoritative comparable value for listing-time comparisons; do not mix heterogeneous proxies unless explicitly required and normalized.
